custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test on an earlier day after this release, date A, at a cost of $10.00, with 0 in its only bin.
  • Add 2 of part A to a work order line on date A while its bin holds 0, so part A ended date A at -2 and the report saved that figure for date A.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value), with the as-of date on today.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C540878 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C540878-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 0. Click Save.
  2. When: Do the item above one day before you run the test, then run the test the next day, so the report has saved a figure for that earlier date.
  3. On that same day:
  4. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C540878 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
  5. Put part A on the line: In the line's Parts row click + Add Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C540878-A in Part number and pick the result that shows Inventory Qty. Type 2 in Qty *. Click Save.
